title: Pickle Pub Crawl in Victoria's Inner Harbour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Participants embark on a leisurely journey hopping between waterfront pubs and bars, savoring local brews and delicious Victoria inspired cocktails along the way. What sets this crawl apart is the mode of transportation: instead of walking or driving between venues, attendees board charming harbour ferries to navigate the waters, enjoying scenic views of the city skyline and iconic landmarks.

Led by fun and knowledgeable guides, this Pub Crawl promises not only a delightful culinary adventure but also a memorable exploration of Victoria's breathtaking waterfront. Whether you're a visitor looking to experience the city from a unique perspective or a local eager to discover hidden gems along the harbour, this tour offers a refreshing and unforgettable taste of Victoria's culture. Join this public tour and make some new friends in your city!

This is a great way to celebrate a Bachelor, Bachelorette or Birthday party! We have trivia and giveaways for the whole group!
